check_diff_summaries.crews: crew size vs boat class, Spotfokus/Memosoft Full Results book (vendor published results; Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20220830085517if_/https://eca2021marathonmoscow.spotfokus.com/uploads/XML_Provas/56/pdf/Results/Full%20Results.pdf)
check_diff_summaries.OBS: DNF verbatim from Spotfokus/Memosoft Full Results book (vendor published results; Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20220830085517if_/https://eca2021marathonmoscow.spotfokus.com/uploads/XML_Provas/56/pdf/Results/Full%20Results.pdf) (the book prints no DNS rows)
check_diff_summaries.RANK vs official results: RANK = printed place of Spotfokus/Memosoft Full Results book (vendor published results; Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20220830085517if_/https://eca2021marathonmoscow.spotfokus.com/uploads/XML_Provas/56/pdf/Results/Full%20Results.pdf) (rank_oracle)
check_diff_summaries.PERSONS vs ICF: PERSONS from bind_seat-accepted seats, names as printed in Spotfokus/Memosoft Full Results book (vendor published results; Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20220830085517if_/https://eca2021marathonmoscow.spotfokus.com/uploads/XML_Provas/56/pdf/Results/Full%20Results.pdf)
check_diff_summaries.repairs: name-bound seats vs printed names in Spotfokus/Memosoft Full Results book (vendor published results; Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20220830085517if_/https://eca2021marathonmoscow.spotfokus.com/uploads/XML_Provas/56/pdf/Results/Full%20Results.pdf)
check_diff_summaries.fixtures: skill fixtures are sprint meetings (none in this meeting); binder unchanged; reference Spotfokus/Memosoft Full Results book (vendor published results; Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20220830085517if_/https://eca2021marathonmoscow.spotfokus.com/uploads/XML_Provas/56/pdf/Results/Full%20Results.pdf)

printed_field_counts.source: boats per race as parsed from the published source (https://web.archive.org/web/20220830085517if_/https://eca2021marathonmoscow.spotfokus.com/uploads/XML_Provas/56/pdf/Results/Full%20Results.pdf); back-filled 2026-10-19 from the published RESULTS (the builder parse), race coverage cross-checked independently by GATE10b
